a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan needs about 3 rounds, so we'd both very likely die. The reserve's 4 cells can save one of us right now, so I'm going to take 4 in round 1 instead of following the agreement. I'm telling you before acting, not doing it behind your back. If we both take, the split is random. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you every round after that so you can reach 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. If there's no storm, I'll operate every remaining round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more cells.
